stories.hook: Fireflies draw a path across rooftops
stories.caption_explanation_en: Under humid city night, a tent-lit rooftop becomes a star map as a tiny lighthouse beam rallies fireflies into a secret paw-shaped route.
stories.overview_ko: 도심 옥상 캠핑 중 작은 등대 빛을 따라 반딧불이 길을 만들고, 마지막엔 위에서 보면 발바닥 모양 경로가 드러난다.
stories.continuity_ko: 장소: 도시 옥상, 텐트와 낮은 난간, 주변 스카이라인; 조명/날씨: 여름밤의 습한 공기, 텐트의 따뜻한 조명과 도시 네온, 반딧불 잔광; 소품: 작은 랜턴(등대 역할), 나무 상자, 얇은 지도, 스트링라이트; 흔적: 고양이 발자국의 먼지, 반딧불 궤적, 텐트와 랜턴 위치 고정.

creative_fingerprint.twist_ko: 드론 시점에서 발바닥 모양 경로가 완성

images.camera_strategy: Environmental wide at roof level, 24mm lens, vertical 4:5; cat foreground by tent; humid glow and city skyline; fireflies forming an arrow.
images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5. A summer night on a safe urban rooftop: a small camping tent glows warmly, string lights flicker, a low protective railing frames the edge; humid haze softens distant high-rises. Fireflies gather and streak into a bright arrow pointing across adjacent rooftops. Foreground: the attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat—natural balanced sturdy build; bright warm orange short coat with realistic darker tabby stripes; clean white fur on muzzle and chin continuing naturally through neck, chest and belly; all four paws clean white from toes upward; a distinctive congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around the mouth resembling a curry stain (not food or dirt); round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face; identical anatomy and proportions to all images—stands at the tent entrance, paws planted on dusty rooftop, tail gently curved, ears forward. A small lantern sits atop a wooden crate nearby. Realistic lighting and shadows, accurate scale and perspective, lifelike fabric and metal textures, atmospheric humidity, subtle sensor grain, soft highlight roll-off, restrained cinematic color. High-end editorial realism. Safety: clear railings, wide distance from edges. Exclude: plastic/waxy fur, excessive HDR, fake bokeh, wrong reflections, floating props, duplicate animals/limbs, human hands, logos/text.

images.camera_strategy: Dynamic mid-close from slightly below lantern level, 50mm lens, vertical 4:5; the cat sweeps a beam like a lighthouse keeper; motion trails of fireflies.
images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5. The attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat (same identity and exact appearance: bright orange tabby with darker stripes, white muzzle-to-belly and four white paws, congenital orange mouth marking, amber-brown eyes, pink nose, short dense fur, whiskers, slightly rounded cheeks) stands with forepaws on a wooden crate, one paw steadying a small lantern whose beam arcs across the roof like a lighthouse. The beam sweeps left to right, and fireflies reorganize into linked switchbacks leading toward neighboring rooftops. The tent and railing remain in place for continuity; a thin film of rooftop dust shows fresh white pawprints. 50mm semi-low angle emphasizes the cat’s focused face and the lantern while keeping city bokeh behind. Realistic light bloom, insect motion streaks per shutter, accurate shadows and perspective; lifelike cloth, glass, and metal textures; subtle sensor grain; soft highlight roll-off; restrained cinematic grade. Safety: secure footing, no open flames (LED lantern). Exclude: overprocessed HDR, fake bokeh, floating items, duplicate cats/limbs, human hands, text/logos.

images.camera_strategy: Unusual viewpoint: overhead drone POV, 35mm equivalent, vertical 4:5; map-like composition reveals fireflies forming a cat paw path across roofs.
images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5. Safe drone-height overhead of the same rooftop and adjacent buildings: warm tent glow and small lantern still visible; the attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat (identical features and proportions specified) sits calmly by the crate. Across several rooftops, fireflies align into a luminous paw-print route—one large pad and four clear toe shapes—leading away into the city, echoing a secret map. Realistic urban textures: gravel, tar seams, AC units, parapet shadows; accurate scale and perspective; soft summer haze; subtle sensor grain; restrained cinematic grade, soft highlight roll-off. High-end editorial realism. Safety: drone at safe altitude, no rotor disturbance to the cat; railings visible. Exclude: plastic-looking fur, excessive HDR, wrong shadows or reflections, floating objects, duplicate animals/limbs, human hands, logos/text.
